cards.name: Dramatic Accusation
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature.
Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.
{U}{U}: Shuffle enchanted creature into its owner's library.

cards.name: Dramatic Rescue
cards.oracleText: Return target creature to its owner's hand. You gain 2 life.

cards.name: Dramatic Reversal
cards.oracleText: Untap all nonland permanents you control.

cards.name: Dramatic Entrance
cards.oracleText: You may put a green creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Dramatist's Puppet
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, for each kind of counter on target permanent, put another counter of that kind on it or remove one from it.

cards.name: Dramatic Finale
cards.oracleText:
Creature tokens you control get +1/+1.
Whenever one or more nontoken creatures you control die, create a 2/1 white and black Inkling creature token with flying. This ability triggers only once each turn.
